conclusion: Every historical arm in this project was trained under a press-weighted objective. 5 arms used onset-10x and 6 used onset-10x + sustain-5x; the only plain-BCE arms are stage-2 arm A and the new script_net plain arm. The measured A-rate is ordered by press-weighting strength -- onset-10x at [0.628] sits strictly below every sustain arm at [0.822, 0.852, 0.865, 0.888, 0.97] -- which is what the mechanism predicts across arms, not just within one run.
retraction_scope: No clearance figure from an onset-10x or sustain arm can be read as a skill claim on its own. It must be reported beside `vs_script`, because the objective moved the marginal and a fixed-rate script with the same marginal already matches or beats these arms at pipes 1-2. Stage-2 arm A is the one historical arm whose objective was unbiased.
